research.searchCoverage: Official Agenty REST root is https://api.agenty.com/v2. Docs accept apikey as a query parameter or X-Agenty-ApiKey header; this recipe uses the header to match pinned source. GET /agents is the pinned credential validator and the documented list-agents endpoint. GET /agents/{agent_id} and GET /jobs match official Agents/Jobs API docs. Operator is Agenty Analytics Private Limited in Gurugram/Bahadurgarh, India. Browser API at browser.agenty.com / api.agenty.ai is a separate host and is not exposed. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Agenty platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
